title: Lowpass Resampler
text: Convert signal from one sample time to another, 1 input, 1 output, {Output sample time} sets Type of output sample time; {Inherit output rise/fall time}, {Output rise/fall time} sets the 20%−80% output rise/fall, {Number of samples of delay} sets the number of samples of propagation delay for fixed-step, {Samples out per rise/fall time} sets the number of output samples in single output rise/fall, {Enable large buffer} enables extra buffer samples and {Number of extra buffer samples}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Inherit output rise/fall time
params.values: Inherit output rise/fall time from fixed-step input sample time on (default) | off

params.name: Output rise/fall time
params.values: 20%−80% output rise/fall time 1e-10 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Number of samples of delay
params.values: Number of samples of propagation delay for fixed-step operation 1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output sample time
params.values: Type of output sample time Inherited (default) | Fixed step discrete | Variable step discrete

params.name: Samples out per rise/fall time
params.values: Number of output samples in single output rise/fall time 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Enable large buffer
params.values: Enable extra buffer samples on (default) | off

params.name: Number of extra buffer samples
params.values: Number of extra buffer samples to support sample delays 10 (default) | positive real scalar
